method: Each document is classified into exactly one category by hostname (with label boundary) or by an Afghan-service path on a multi-service broadcaster. Near-duplicates sharing a host and opening 300 characters are counted separately and excluded from the character total.

projection_full_subset.note: Linear projection of the measured unique share onto the full 58,887,122-document subset. The stream is not shuffled, so the head may not be representative.

limitations: Single unshuffled pass over the head of one config. Domain is a proxy for dialect: an .af site may publish Iranian Persian and an Afghan author may publish on a .com. The host list is hand-collected and not exhaustive, so the true yield is likely higher. bbc.com/persian is deliberately excluded as Iran-facing. No rights review performed.
